conceptZh: 圓滾滾的扭蛋小怪獸追著從畫面邊緣探頭的「爸」字，大怪獸爸爸和小怪獸爸爸輪流躲貓貓，最後上面的「父」和下面的「巴」安靜坐好。
object: a round fuzzy pocket creature bursting from a gachapon capsule, and a much bigger fuzzy creature parent peeking in from the edges
morph: the upper part 父 and lower part 巴 of 爸 keep sneaking in from the edges and dodging, then settle stacked in place
creativeAngle: 躲貓貓：字的上半「父」和下半「巴」輪流從畫面邊緣探頭、閃開，小怪獸追不到，最後大怪獸現身，兩半一起落位。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and warm, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-mint backdrop with a soft cream floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated tomato-red Traditional Chinese glyph 爸, the 父 component stacked on top of the 巴 component, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with generous margins. The lead is an original round fuzzy orange pocket creature with big eyes and stubby feet that pops out of a split gachapon capsule and bounces off everything; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the capsule cracks open at center and the little creature boings out, bouncing off the floor and the left wall; the first spoken 爸 lands as the red 父 shape pokes in from the top edge, waves its strokes like a hello, and zips back out of sight. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the creature spins around, confused, and chases it; the red 巴 slides up from the bottom edge, pokes its hook out, then ducks behind the capsule shell; the creature lifts the shell and finds nothing, eyes crossed, and the second spoken 爸 lands as both halves leap out from opposite edges and dodge him once more. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): the creature stamps his foot, puffs up round as a ball, and a second, much bigger fuzzy creature with a gentle smile lifts him up in one soft paw; the two halves rush in and click together into 爸 as the word 爸爸 is spoken, the little creature clapping its paws. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 爸 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in red; the big creature sets the little one on its shoulder, and the little one waves both arms and wobbles with joy, far from the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「爸、爸、爸爸」, read as ㄅㄚˋ、ㄅㄚˋ、ㄅㄚˋ ㄅㄚ˙, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.8s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft boings and a gentle chime under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
